title: iPollo VI Enterprise Presentation · 38 Native Slides
description: A high-fidelity native-editable enterprise presentation template rebuilt from 38 iPollo VI Figma layouts with deterministic geometry, replaceable image frames, and local assets.

source.name: iPollo VI (Figma node 139 set)
source.attribution: Converted from the user-provided Figma nodes for iPolloWork use.

applyChecklist: Rewrite every data-pptx-text object for the requested purpose while preserving the selected node 139 slide order and exact geometry.
Preserve all slide roots and native PPT object markers; keep every SVG line, connector, arrow, and complex vector embedded as an export-safe image data URL.
Keep the Figma white-space, line-height, and text-frame behavior to prevent unintended wrapping or clipping.
Replace editable image objects only when the brief supplies an appropriate visual.
Never invent metrics; mark missing evidence for replacement before presenting.
